answer: Each identity posts a 60-credit bond in the vault and needs one sponsor endorsement in the wharf registry. Each sponsor endorses at most three identities per epoch, and registering locks a 150-credit sponsor bond. Auditors publish a knoll checkpoint each epoch; a proven fake forfeits its vault bond and its sponsor loses quota and sponsor bond. The k-th fake costs 60 credits, or 210 when it needs a new sponsor, so 1,000 fakes lock 110,100 credits with no reuse. A rented sponsor ring fails, since its fan-out is visible in the wharf registry. An honest agent posts one bond.
